data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for creating and checking local PIN code screens with flexible settings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a PIN code screen widget inspired by Android, supporting variable PIN lengths, enter callbacks, and a customizable center bottom widget.
use_when: You need a dedicated PIN code input screen for local authentication.
You want a PIN widget with customizable minimum and maximum length.
avoid_when: You need complex form validation frameworks beyond PIN entry.
You require an out-of-the-box secure storage wrapper tied directly to the PIN.
strengths: Supports flexible PIN lengths from minimum to maximum bounds.
Includes a centerBottomWidget property for additional buttons like biometrics.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic usage examples.
Does not include built-in storage or crypto check mechanisms out-of-the-box.
